title: 11. Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami (Inu Inu no Mi)

plan.english: 11. Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami (Inu Inu no Mi)
plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird orange#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird orange fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: you got the Dog-Dog#pink Fruit,#pink Model:#pink Okuchi#pink no#pink Makami,#pink
lines.say: you got the Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami,

lines.text: a Mythical#orange Zoan that turns you into a holy wolf guardian.#gold
lines.say: a Mythical Zoan that turns you into a holy wolf guardian.

lines.text: First, you turn into a giant#green white#pink wolf.
lines.say: First, you turn into a giant white wolf.

lines.text: Then you can freeze#blue anything#green with icy cold power.
lines.say: Then you can freeze anything with icy cold power.

lines.text: You can even make barriers#pink to protect#purple the people around you.
lines.say: You can even make barriers to protect the people around you.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue attack mixes the wolf's power with Conqueror's#blue Haki.
lines.say: Your strongest attack mixes the wolf's power with Conqueror's Haki.

lines.text: This fruit is a guardian deity of Wano, a protector,#orange not a destroyer.#red
lines.say: This fruit is a guardian deity of Wano, a protector, not a destroyer.

lines.text: Yamato,#pink Kaido's child, used it to protect#green Wano from Kaido.
lines.say: Yamato, Kaido's child, used it to protect Wano from Kaido.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never need air conditioning.#orange
lines.say: Users of this fruit never need air conditioning.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
